CBR City identity: black and deep forest-green base with vivid emerald/neon green architectural lighting and polished metallic details. Realistic cinematic GTA Online inspired environment screenshot with clear readable subject at 512x256. Reference logo only for black/emerald palette and urban mood, do not draw the logo. No text, no labels, no prices, no real company logos, no watermarks, no collage, no border. Keep upper 15 percent subdued and dark for native game title overlay.
